d:
A commissioned series done by spiderweber (https://www.deviantart.com/spiderweber) for RetailRobbery. Below is the story described:
——
The Tri Theta sorority was know for being quite lavish, with only the most prestigious students and "den mothers" accepted to their hallowed halls. Often the sisters would be seen preening themselves in the windows of their mansion-esque dorms, dressed in the sorority mandated Bathrobes provided to them as a welcome gift. Often members of the chapter came from the upper echelon of society; business majors from bank moguls, daughters of CEOs, And the worst of the bunch by far... hoity toity fine arts majors (I say as a fine arts major myself. lol).

Unfortunately for the Sorority sisters, they would soon find themselves in the crosshairs of an escaped science experiment.

A swarm of giant spiders crept through the night, accompanied by hundreds if not thousands of their young. They swarmed from the biology lab, driven by an insatiable hunger.

Perhaps it was by instinct (or maybe sheer bad luck) that the swarm of mutant spiders had been attracted to the lingering sweet aromas that seemed to permeate from within the massive structure. Flowery smells usually meant a wonderful place to snare bugs of all sorts... and they were right.

Mint (Skunk) and Freyja (Snow Leopard) slept soundly in their rooms, after having spent the evening partying until neither of them could stave off the growing exhaustion. The two were so deep in their slumber, oblivious to the world outside their own minds, that they failed to notice the massive, lumbering creatures making their way into the bedroom.

The door creaked open as the massive arachnid invited itself in, followed by a trio of smaller, but still impossibly large spiders. What a stroke of luck in finding a pair of fluffy moths asleep.

The spiders made their way over to the two damsels, tiptoeing silently upon their spindly legs. The group softly prodding at the two with their forelegs, testing their reaction to the stimuli.

Neither woman awoke. Rather, they both groaned at the touch, and rolled themselves over, before drifting back to sleep.

The spiders went about their work, coating the floor of the abode with a mesh of sticky silk and turning the abode into a brand new den. A hammock was strewn between the beds, allowing the smaller spiders easy access to their prey. But by bit they tossed and threw silk across the two, the soft, nearly weightless silk tickled at the womens' fur, causing them to shuffle about.

The scene continued on, the spiders weaving and wrapping over and over again, until Freyja had been spun up, her body cocooned in a haphazard mess of spiderwebs.

Finally, Freyja began to stir, a soft grumble escaping her lips as she started to feel a bit uncomfortably warm. Her tail had been coiled around her body, hugging the snow leopard tightly within it, and trapping her arms beneath.

She groaned, eyes softly opening to find that she couldn't speak... couldn't move... something was covering her body, soaking wet goo into her fur and clothing. What was this? some sort of prank?

Her eyes shot open, expecting to see a group of her sisters surrounding her bed, having jokingly taped her down... but the truth was far more shocking.

She looked down to her body, her heart starting to race as she watched the trio of spiders crawl over her chest, moving back and forth as they layered their excretions across her form.

"HHHHHMPH!? MMMMMM!!!" She screamed out, but her mouth had been sealed over, stuffed with silk to impede any shouts for help.

As she writhed, her body finally starting to buck against the silk, the spiders took note, each of them moving to secure her down to the bed. There was no way she would escape their craftsmanship.

Her gaze drifted over to the other bed, where she noticed that her roommate Mint was nowhere to be seen... until movement from the ceiling caught her attention.

Mint sat in the grasp of a massive arachnid. The skunk such a heavy sleeper that she didn't even awaken as her body tumbled around and around within its legs. A wet *Schlick* of silk spewed forth from the spider's bulbous abdomen as it cradled her spreading silk across her face like a tight sleep mask and swaddling her form in the same stretchy gunk that covered Freyja's own body.

Freyja called out to her, pleading for her to wake up, butt her voice had been stifled.

She whimpered, looking back to the monsters webbing her to the bed. Her only hope now was that someone in the house would find her before the siders found them.

Freyja's muffled screams continued on unheard as the spiders went about their work, there was nothing she nor Mint could do to pull themselves out of their stretchy, sticky silk prison.

Meanwhile, a few rooms over another pair of Sorority sisters weren't fairing any better. The two had been awakened to the sight of a pair of massive arachnids, taking advantage of the open window into their room.

"What the hell is that!?" Velvet cried out as the buxom red panda stumbled backward onto her rear. Her orange and yellow robe billowing out on the floor behind her.

Beth, stood frozen in fear, unable to comprehend the terrifying monstrosity in front of her. She turned to run for the door, but felt a tug as the spider pinned down the train of her own garment, and yanked her back into its legs.

Before they knew it, the two were hoisted into the air, strung up like marionettes ready for their performance.

The two screamed for help, trying to warn anyone from the adjacent rooms, but unfortunately for them no expense was spared in building the massive manor, including sound dampening walls to ensure the privacy of the pledges. There had been FAR too many noise complaints when one of the gals brought back their boyfriends for a wild evening of passion.

The spider's climbed up the girl's bodies, their legs prodding, and toying at the two, causing them both to squirm.

"AH-HAHAHA! S-Stop!" Velvet's whimpers and cries were interrupted by bouts of uncontrollable laugher.

"We... We ha-HAHAHA! We have to get out of here, Let us G-OOHHHHHH!!!" Beth let out a yelp as one of the spider's legs pulled down at her top, exposing the Cheetah's bare chest.

They pulled and twisted, but no matter how they tried to break free, the webs snapped back into place, leaving the two as nothing more than a pair of moths for the spiders to spin up.

Out in the halls, den mother Karla and Beth made their rounds for the evening.

The night had been calm and relaxing for the two, with almost none of the sorority sisters attempting to bring in unauthorized guests, or playing their usual pranks on the others. Normally this would be a relief for them both, but... it was so utterly unusual that it caused more trepidation than anything else.

The two turned the corner, meeting up with one another in one of the many long hallways that connected to each of the rooms.

"Anything on your end?" Karla asked.

Ruth simply shook her head, "not a thing, which is... kind of worrying."

"Tell me about it."

Karla felt a sudden tickle upon her muzzle, and reached up her hand to wave away the loose hair brushing against her nose. As she did so, however, her sleeve seemed to collect more and more of the glistening strands.

"What on earth?" Karla looked down to her arm, seeing it covered in hundreds of loose, impossibly thin threads, "Huh... I think we need to call for some cleaners, it looks like we might have a cobweb problem."

Karla looked back to Ruth, who's face had gone pale, a look of utter disgust and terror now marring her visage. She wasn't looking at Karla, instead, her gaze was fixed behind her, her body trembling.

"What're you..." Karla turned to look, realizing just what had disturbed Ruth so heavily.

Along the wall thousands of small spiders crawled about, leaving behind trails of glistening webs. Karla followed the trail down toward the floor, and to her horror... right toward the two gorgeous girls. They were everywhere, many of them starting to cluster around the bottom of their garments and, as they began to feel the prickling, itching sensations on their legs, their own bodies.

The sudden realization lead to a panic in the two, the both of them starting to swat and itch wildly at their own bodies. Their limps flailed about their legs trying desperately to kick away the pests, but no matter how many they managed to throw, ten more easily took their place.

"What the fuck! Get the hell off me!" Ruth screamed out as she swatted with her arm. A tug of resistance stifled her movements, and as she looked around, she realized just why it was becoming so hard to move. The two had walked themselves right into a mass of glue coated webs, the haphazard mesh entangling the two within.

The spiders continued their assault, each one trailing more and more of the disgusting material around their bodies, making it all the harder for them to escape. They were like moths blundering into a well placed trap, and it was quickly dawning on them just how incredibly strong and elastic spiderwebs truly were as they were draped over.

Karla reached behind her, her hand scratching at her backside when her fingers gushed into a freshly laid patch of silk, instantly affixing it in that awkward position.

"Shit! I can't get my hand... NNGGGGHHH!!! I can't get my hand loose!" She cried out as she felt the swarm of spider spring into action, crisscrossing the webs across her palm until there was no way she could pull it loose.

The mass of arachnids only seemed to grow as they came spilling from the vents overhead, dropping into their hair and clothing. The flow seemed to never end as soon the two were overtaken, the tiny attackers quickly performing the arduous task of cocooning their prey.
